items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: That's when I first met George Lewis.

ctx.x: Well, I didn't stay long the first time because I was on my way to my old hometown which was in Mississippi which is about five or six hours drive from New Orleans. I stayed there for about two weeks and then I went back to New Orleans and stayed in New Orleans for about
two weeks. That's when I met some old friends and went down to Preservation Hall and that's when I first met George Lewis.
Was he the first leader of that Preservation Hall band?
